post.description:
Use for review text and ratings of a known Target product (url or tcin from featured or variants). To sync incrementally, call with sort=newest and since set to the latest submitted_at you already hold, or stop paging at a known review_id. A query exposes at most 2550 reviews; larger products are read per star rating, and the output warns where a rating bucket is cut short.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call. Pass every other input unchanged.

page_size.description:
Reviews per source page; a call reads up to 8 pages.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 50.

rating.description:
Only reviews with this star rating.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5.

since.description: With sort=newest: stop at the first review submitted before this UTC date or datetime (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Use it for incremental sync.

sort.description:
newest is by submission date, descending. Within one rating or one query, ties keep newest first.

Provider reference: allowed values ["newest", "most_helpful", "highest", "lowest"]; default "newest".

tcin.description: Numeric TCIN, as returned by featured and variants. Use instead of url. Pattern: ^[0-9]{6,12}$.

url.description: HTTPS www.target.com product URL ending /-/A-<numeric TCIN>, without query or fragment. Pattern: ^https://www\.target\.com/p/(?:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/)?-/A-[0-9]{6,12}$.

reviews.text: upgraded from a Series 9 to Series 12. Great choice, much better battery life and series 12 is great. So glad I upgraded.
reviews.title: Great upgrade from Series 9 watch

reviews.text: The bezels make the screen look so small. The battery life isn’t any better. If you have a series 10 or 11, skip this one. It’s a step backwards
reviews.title: Step backwards.. not forward..

reviews.text: Battery lasts so much longer than series 11- I can wear for over 24 hours before recharging and it charges fast. Otherwise, not many new changes to the 12 but happy to upgrade. I use it mainly to track steps, workouts and sleep and works great!
reviews.title: Longer battery life and excellent tracking

reviews.text: Box came dirty and gross which is a shame because this is a gift
